experiment: E7 — OpenAI embeddings for story matching: 512 vs 1536 dimensions vs the local MiniLM baseline
why: The maintainer chose the OpenAI API for embeddings (A56). The open question is the vector size: 512 keeps the hot database small (A52), 1536 is the model's full size. MiniLM (384 dimensions, local) is today's baseline, calibrated 2026-10-11.
data: The 7-day story window as of the run (2.3 input: canonical articles, one vector per article = mean over headline versions, A35), and the 200 labelled article pairs in data/eval (100 'band' pairs sampled around MiniLM's similarity threshold, 100 'deployed' pairs that MiniLM's clustering put together; all 200 inside the window; labelled by Claude).
procedure: pipeline.embed.calibrate for A and for B (each: embed the 14-day window, sweep the story threshold 0.30–0.90 on the labelled pairs with average-linkage clustering, quantile-map the 2.1 thresholds). Then pipeline.experiments.e7 (free) on the stored vectors.
primary_metric: Pair-level recall at the operating point calibrate selects: the threshold with the highest recall whose precision is at least MiniLM's precision at its own threshold 0.60 (A47). Same procedure for every model, so the in-sample threshold choice favours all of them equally.

questions.Q1: Does B reach at least MiniLM's recall at MiniLM's precision? Report recall, precision, F1 per model with 95 % bootstrap intervals (2,000 resamples of the labelled pairs).
questions.Q2_decision: Is A within 0.03 recall of B? Paired bootstrap of recall(A) − recall(B) at each model's selected threshold. Decision rule: keep 512 unless B's recall is higher by more than 0.03 AND the 95 % interval of the difference excludes 0; then take 1536.
questions.Q3_exploratory: Dimension curve, free: truncate B's stored vectors to 64, 128, 256, 512, 768, 1024 dimensions, re-normalise, re-sweep. Does recall at MiniLM's precision stay flat down to 256?
questions.Q4_exploratory: Is the API's 512-d output the same as B truncated to 512 and re-normalised? Mean cosine between the two per article; expected > 0.999.

also_reported: bytes per vector and per 30-day window (≈ 48,000 articles)
best F1 over the sweep per model
limitations_known_in_advance: The labelled pairs were selected using MiniLM (its similarity band and its clusters), so pairs MiniLM rated as clearly different are absent: recall of a new model on stories MiniLM missed completely cannot be measured here. 200 pairs give wide intervals (≈ ±0.07 on recall). Labels are Claude's; the maintainer's spot-check of 10 is still open (VERIFY.md).
rules: No change to the clustering method, the label set or the threshold grid after seeing results without a new pre-registration. No claims (pipeline phase); method findings may go to docs/FINDINGS.md.
